title: Pakistan Air Strikes on Kunar and Helmand Kill at Least 10 Civilians, UN Says
detail: Pakistan struck what it called TTP and Balochistan Liberation Army camps in Kunar and Helmand provinces on October 1, 2026. Islamabad said 22 fighters were killed; the Taliban reported at least 9 civilians dead, including women and children, 11 wounded and three houses destroyed. UNAMA documented at least 10 civilian deaths, mostly children, and 9 injured, and called for de-escalation. The strikes follow Pakistan's September 24 raids on Kandahar, Paktia and Khost.

media.caption: Afghan and Pakistani tensions after Pakistani air strikes
